_note: STARTER VALUES ONLY. Approximate ranges from general agronomy knowledge. Verify every number with Assam Agricultural University (AAU), your district KVK, or the FAO EcoCrop database before showing advice to farmers. 'ph', 'rain_mm' (annual), 'temp_c' (annual mean), 'clay_pct' are each [min, max] optimum ranges.

crops.name: Sali rice (winter rice)
crops.notes: Needs standing water; heavy clay holds water well.

crops.name: Ahu rice (autumn rice)
crops.notes: Shorter duration; needs well-distributed spring rain.

crops.name: Tea
crops.notes: Needs acidic, well-drained soil. Waterlogging kills roots.

crops.name: Jute
crops.notes: Prefers loamy alluvial soil, near-neutral pH.

crops.name: Mustard
crops.notes: Dry-season crop; needs good drainage after monsoon.

crops.name: Potato
crops.notes: Needs loose, well-drained soil; avoid waterlogged fields.

crops.name: Banana
crops.notes: Needs fertile, well-drained soil; sensitive to wind and flooding.
